mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month indicates a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the previous two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator for economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the periods with sustained increases in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous two months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates strong consumer demand, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS grows by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction between a decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increasing nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) suggests a robust labor market, which is a strong signal for positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE decreases and PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy in a low-growth environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: restrictive monetary policy in low-growth environment
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is above 2% and GDPC1 growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of increasing housing starts (HOUST) and rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand expansion, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are increasing.
